title: Actual native quality cadence configuration through Connect
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 Store and actual signed native listener/public SDK, EdDSA and ES256. This component does not close G6-046 or qualify remote, Linux, browser or provider acceptance.
implementation: Validated immutable connection.update/action quality accepts integers 100..60000; required original operation/full scopes/expected stream revision; rejects mixed known media controls. Public Rust Command is Update, wire name unchanged, no legacy alias.

Store private attempt captures exact interval. Only actual returned local configuration can become a completion receipt with original connection generation, unchanged stream revision and resources_changed false. Atomic historical recording never revives retired media or reapplies a completed receipt over newer cadence.

Service checks exact actual physical owner and current named connection.update permission. Original source guards are prepared before engine locks; the synchronous callback purely checks exact original command/current binding. Returned definite refusal has no effect; panic/interruption retains uncertainty. Captured storage recovery drops original source readers and never repeats configuration.

CanonicalClient.configure_native_quality preserves immutable caller scope/interval, validates completed result and returns preparing/failed/unknown outcomes for original reconciliation. HTTP reference explicitly records the native-only profile.
actual_cases: Both signature algorithms: configure700 then1800; observe actual measured intervals with packet counters; original700 replay returns historical result while fresh cadence stays1800. Original media bindings/revision/timebase survive, and marked audio remains usable both ways. Changed immutable intent conflicts, foreign physical source leaves zero admitted operations, stale revision fails and HTTP refuses physical control.

Actual same-owner peer with connection.offer but without named connection.update permission can negotiate media yet cannot configure cadence, has no admitted operation and remains authenticated/usable.

Controlled journal-completion failure after actual800 configuration leaves preparing with actual flow/cadence observed. An Identity writer completes without retained original readers; dropping the fault recovers one original effect without repeating configuration.
